meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 在 Agent 容器镜像里装上 mnemon,每次容器启动都会注册 Claude Code hooks:回复前自动带出相关记忆,每轮对话后再写入新洞察。记忆存在 .claude/ 挂载中,容器重启后仍保留。
howto.when: 只在跑默认 Claude provider 的 agent group 上生效——mnemon hooks 仅对 claude-code 触发;若 group 设了其他 provider(如 opencode),注册的 hooks 不会运行。

say.text: 把 mnemon 装到 Agent 容器镜像里
检查 mnemon hooks 是否已注册
测试 Agent 能不能记起上次会话的内容
say.note: 新开会话引用旧话题,看是否自动带出

howto.what_en: Installs mnemon in the agent container image. On each start, mnemon setup registers Claude Code hooks that surface relevant memory before responding and store new insights after each turn. Memory persists in the .claude/ mount.
howto.when_en: Works only on agent groups running the default Claude provider: mnemon hooks fire only under --target claude-code. If a group sets another provider (e.g. opencode), its hooks do not run.

say_en.text: Install mnemon in the agent container image.
say_en.note: Adds the Docker layer and registers hooks at startup.

say_en.text: Check whether the mnemon hooks are registered.
Test whether the agent recalls the last session.
say_en.note: Start a new session and reference an old topic.
